fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant found that the main gate near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony had been damaged overnight, causing a loss of roughly Rs. 3,00,000. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2025-10-05, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-04 around 02:50 hrs. Contact details given by the complainant, Lavanya Raj, include the number 9000000127. Harish Babu (9000000422) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A person named Rakesh Muthu, associated with the number 9000000045, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complaint refers to Vasanth Mani, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000382.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Damage reportedly caused overnight by unidentified persons.
